status: ENV-02 design proposal (phase 1): full opening route for review and CHASE-01 / CP-03 planning; not authored level geometry, not wired into floor01_scene
coordinate_system: top_left origin, x right, y down, rows top_to_bottom; piece x/y = top-left of the piece rect in layout pixels

R.note: recommended: 212 px clear (DOZ-01 asks >= 200 so smoke and riders read); 57 px above the 155 px pursuer

T.note: tight: 180 px clear (DOZ-01 minimum 164); 25 px above the 155 px pursuer, so its smoke flattens against the soffit and the stack may scrape (spark VFX)

pursuer_clearance.rule: clearance = walking line - lowered cornice underside; DOZ-01 needs >= 164 px (>= 200 recommended): R (212) is the default, T (180) the tight alternative

segments.purpose: calm intro: plain brick, one pooled torch, a closed timber door
arch bay; the pursuer enters from the gallery through this window
maintenance passage: low ceiling (option R/T), copper run, valve, hatch, two timber sets the pursuer smashes, two jump humps
widened passage: full height, dodge alcove on a 1-tile ledge, timber barricade the pursuer charges through (overshoot)
arch bay where the pursuer wedges; on-foot skirmish with the CP-03 raking shore and its fall region
guild portal: safe, warm, protected exit

markers.note: actor pivot pixel (foot contact row = walking line - 1)
respawn for a failed chase: inside S3, before the trigger
leading player crosses -> pursuer spawns behind (authored event)
pursuer emerges from the gallery through the S2 arch window (turn-in is presentation); body enters the lane at the window centre
lane path at the walking line; ceiling clearance in S3 is design_parameters.pursuer_clearance
ceiling option T: walking line to cornice underside
presentation + authored event: swap to timber_set_smashed when the pursuer front crosses rect x; no collision, no damage
1-tile raised paving: hop or step while fleeing

leading player crosses x -> the pursuer charges if the gap is >= 140 px (DOZ-01); the refuge entrance is 176 px ahead: 57 ticks at 185 px/s, 73 at 145 px/s, inside the 90-tick charge; momentum carries it past the alcove into the barricade

refuge the pursuer cannot follow (clear height 104 px < 155 px pursuer; DOZ-01 range 64..116). 80 px wide: Carl and Donut fit together. Actors whose feet are on the ledge inside it are skipped by pursuer contact and drawn behind it
blocks actors until the pursuer reaches it (or a fallback timer); then removed and swapped to timber_barricade_smashed
overshoot end: the pursuer cannot make the turn and noses into the S5 arch window; it leaves the lane (no collision) and its riders bail out
CP-03: any melee hit on the shore advances intact -> damaged_1 -> damaged_2 -> broken
drops straight down after the break; one impact event on landing
evaluated once, on the landing tick; the strike position is outside it
no breakable, hazard or scripted blocker may overlap; floor is reinforced
walk into the guild portal; it opens (closed -> open) when a player enters the rect

parallax_rule: Same as ENV-01: screen x = x_origin + k * strip_width + u - camera_x * parallax.

actor_contact_shadow.note: soft ellipse centred on each actor's walking-line contact; darkens the scene group only

preview.note: Art-preview inputs only (not runtime data): approved actor atlases for the readability check.
